scope: Explicit source-file versions in shared Bot settings, private recipient views, Pi read capability, Web and native-client downloads
skipped: Existing Linux-only file-descriptor race and dedicated UID checks on macOS; the new source-file Linux branch also lacks real Linux acceptance.

behaviorEvidence.ownerSettings: Only explicitly selected file IDs and captured byte revisions enter the existing CAS/idempotent sharing save. Bounded remote search finds candidates beyond the first 200; selected stale/missing entries remain visible until explicitly changed.
behaviorEvidence.sourceRead: No source context initialization or writes; descriptor and identity checks reject links, special files, limits and read-time changes. Sequential grant validation enforces actual total bytes without retaining every file buffer.
behaviorEvidence.recipientIsolation: Real account HTTP verifies recipient, source owner, peer, operator, expected-account and active sharing boundaries. Only approved file metadata is visible; full source workspace listing, paths and credentials remain private.
behaviorEvidence.versionAndRevocation: Same-size content edits invalidate the approved revision. Reconfirmation rotates grants; old requests cannot restore removed files. Used-file checks remain in root authorization after delegated runs finish.
behaviorEvidence.runtime: Actual Pi SDK against a synthetic endpoint reads only listed shared file IDs through bounded text/PDF/DOCX/image parsing. Recipient model credentials and private workspace remain separate; source bytes are not copied to personal file storage.
behaviorEvidence.frontend: Actual React handlers preserve immutable sharing drafts and pin downloads to account, shared revision and selected file. Same-count updates refresh; late lists and bytes cannot overwrite the current view or trigger stale saves.
behaviorEvidence.desktop: Native save bridge accepts only exact authenticated file routes after recent user input. It validates account/version after file I/O, cancels on lifecycle changes, and guards destination identity. Tests use synthetic Electron events and real temporary files; they are not native UI acceptance.
behaviorEvidence.cleanup: Independent review reproduced a renamed-parent plaintext temporary-file leak in the initial bridge. Keeping the original file handle permits truncate/sync before identity-matched best-effort unlink. Published files are marked immediately and never truncated by later cleanup failures.

regressionHistory.finalFullServer: Passed after final server changes; all 178 server/shared source hashes remain unchanged.
regressionHistory.finalClient: All 279 source/client and desktop tests rerun after cleanup fixes; source snapshot unchanged afterward.
regressionHistory.targetedTestCorrection: A focused HTTP assertion initially expected 409 for a revision no longer granted after owner reconfirmation; corrected to the intended 403. No production authorization was weakened.

limitations: Product browser control still reports Local browser use is disabled in Work settings; no product visual, focus, touch or native-save-dialog acceptance.
New Linux source-read branch was not run on a real Linux VM; macOS descriptor/path identity checks are not OS isolation.
Source applications and team knowledge still have no granular sharing grants; private computer capacity is not automatically allocated.
Revocation cannot retract already downloaded copies or erase prior personal messages/model context.

An extreme parent-directory rename can leave a zero-byte temporary file. Post-publication unlink failure may leave a temporary hard link to the successfully saved file. Cross-platform file replacement is not an atomic compare-and-swap guarantee.
Desktop package is local macOS arm64 ad-hoc signed, not distribution signed or notarized.
